<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?import javafx.scene.control.*?> <?import javafx.scene.layout.*?> <?import javafx.geometry.Insets?>
<BorderPane fx:id="rootPane" xmlns:fx="http://javafx.com/fxml" fx:controller="com.example.healthappointment.controller.MainController" stylesheets="@styles.css">
<!-- SIDEBAR --> <left> <HBox styleClass="side-shell"> <VBox styleClass="menu-rail" alignment="TOP_CENTER"> <padding><Insets top="16" left="8" right="8" bottom="16"/></padding> <Button fx:id="hamburgerButton" onAction="#handleToggleSidebar" styleClass="hamburger-btn" focusTraversable="false"> <graphic> <VBox spacing="4" alignment="CENTER"> <Region fx:id="lineTop" styleClass="hamburger-line"/> <Region fx:id="lineMiddle" styleClass="hamburger-line"/> <Region fx:id="lineBottom" styleClass="hamburger-line"/> </VBox> </graphic> </Button> </VBox>
<VBox fx:id="sidebar" styleClass="sidebar" spacing="14" visible="false" managed="false" prefWidth="0.0" minWidth="0.0" maxWidth="240.0"> <padding><Insets top="22" left="18" right="18" bottom="24"/></padding>
<VBox spacing="6" alignment="TOP_LEFT" fillWidth="true"> <Label text="Appointment Dashboard" styleClass="logo sidebar-heading"/> </VBox>
<Separator/>
<VBox spacing="2" alignment="CENTER_LEFT" fillWidth="true"> <Button fx:id="btnAdd" text="Add Appoinment" onAction="#handleAdd" styleClass="nav-btn" maxWidth="1.7976931348623157E308"/> <Region fx:id="underlineAdd" styleClass="nav-underline"/> </VBox> <VBox spacing="2" alignment="CENTER_LEFT" fillWidth="true"> <Button fx:id="btnEdit" text="Edit Appoinment" onAction="#handleUpdate" styleClass="nav-btn" maxWidth="1.7976931348623157E308"/> <Region fx:id="underlineEdit" styleClass="nav-underline"/> </VBox> <VBox spacing="2" alignment="CENTER_LEFT" fillWidth="true"> <Button fx:id="btnDelete" text="Delet Appoinment" onAction="#handleDelete" styleClass="nav-btn" maxWidth="1.7976931348623157E308"/> <Region fx:id="underlineDelete" styleClass="nav-underline"/> </VBox> <VBox spacing="2" alignment="CENTER_LEFT" fillWidth="true"> <Button fx:id="btnDetails" text="View Details" onAction="#handleViewDetails" styleClass="nav-btn" maxWidth="1.7976931348623157E308"/> <Region fx:id="underlineDetails" styleClass="nav-underline"/> </VBox>
<Region VBox.vgrow="ALWAYS"/> </VBox> </HBox> </left>
<!-- TOP BAR --> <top> <HBox styleClass="top-bar"> <padding><Insets top="12" left="20" right="20" bottom="12"/></padding>
<Region HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS"/> <Label text="HealthCare" styleClass="title"/> <Region HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS"/> </HBox> </top>
<!-- MAIN CONTENT --> <center> <VBox fx:id="contentArea" spacing="15" styleClass="content-area"> <padding><Insets top="14" left="16" right="16" bottom="16"/></padding>
<!-- FILTER CARD --> <FlowPane fx:id="filterToolbar" hgap="12" vgap="10" alignment="CENTER_LEFT" prefWrapLength="760.0" styleClass="card filter-card filter-toolbar"> <HBox fx:id="searchShell" spacing="8" alignment="CENTER_LEFT" styleClass="search-shell" prefWidth="520.0" minWidth="240.0" maxWidth="1.7976931348623157E308"> <TextField fx:id="searchField" promptText="Search appointments" styleClass="filter-input" HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS"/> <Label text="⌕" styleClass="search-icon"/> </HBox>
<HBox fx:id="dateGroup" spacing="8" alignment="CENTER_LEFT" styleClass="date-group"> <Label text="Pick Date" styleClass="filter-label"/> <DatePicker fx:id="filterDate" promptText="" prefWidth="124.0" maxWidth="1.7976931348623157E308" styleClass="filter-date" HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS"/> </HBox>
<ComboBox fx:id="filterStatus" promptText="Appointment Status" prefWidth="190.0" maxWidth="1.7976931348623157E308" styleClass="filter-status"/>
<Button fx:id="clearFilterButton" text="Clear" onAction="#handleClearFilter" styleClass="filter-clear-btn"/> </FlowPane>
<!-- TABLE CARD --> <VBox styleClass="card" VBox.vgrow="ALWAYS"> <TableView fx:id="tableView" VBox.vgrow="ALWAYS"> <columnResizePolicy> <TableView fx:constant="CONSTRAINED_RESIZE_POLICY"/> </columnResizePolicy> <columns> <TableColumn fx:id="colId" text="No." prefWidth="50" minWidth="40" maxWidth="70"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colPatientName" text="Patient Name" prefWidth="140" minWidth="100"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colPhone" text="Contact" prefWidth="120" minWidth="90"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colDate" text="Date" prefWidth="110" minWidth="80"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colTime" text="Time" prefWidth="90" minWidth="70"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colDoctor" text="Doctor" prefWidth="120" minWidth="90"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colReason" text="Reason" prefWidth="130" minWidth="100"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colStatus" text="Status" prefWidth="110" minWidth="80"/> </columns> </TableView> </VBox>
</VBox> </center>
</BorderPane>
